name: system-design-signaling-server
description: The session relay for the editor's live collaboration: scripts/relay-server.ts, which speaks y-webrtc's signaling protocol and can additionally require a room token from the workspace store (WS10-R6). With RELAY_TOKEN_SECRET unset it behaves exactly as y-webrtc's own server did. Only its runtime dependency lives here; the image is built from the repository root so the relay's own source is copied in rather than duplicated.
